definitions.explanation: The passing of traits from parents to offspring through genes. Also refers to the scientific field of genetics.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いのに{白髪|しらが}があるのは{遺伝|いでん}かもしれない。
examples.english: Having gray hair at a young age might be genetic.

examples.japanese: {遺伝|いでん}の{影響|えいきょう}は{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The influence of heredity is significant.

examples.japanese: この{病気|びょうき}は{遺伝|いでん}する。

notes:
USAGE: Used both as a noun and with する to form a verb meaning 'to be hereditary.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{遺伝|いでん}する (to be inherited/hereditary)
・{遺伝|いでん}{子|し} (gene)
・{遺伝|いでん}{情報|じょうほう} (genetic information)
・{遺伝|いでん}{病|びょう} (hereditary disease)
・{遺伝|いでん}{子|し}{検査|けんさ} (genetic testing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{遺伝|いでん}{学|がく} (genetics - the field of study)
